title: 第17章 李宏财的报复第18章 审讯风波
content_zh:
;;
李向东傻的这两年，大黄一直都是最贴心的玩伴。
以至于病好后也没有留意它身上的变化。
这会儿被李为民一提醒，才发现作为一只狗来说，它确实有些不正常。
首先是年龄。
村里和它同年龄的狗，早就死的死，埋的埋。
要么就是老到毛发掉光走不动道，过不了这个冬天。
就它还活蹦乱跳，呲牙打起架来甚至比三四岁的壮年公狗还要猛。
经常咬得他们到处乱蹿，独霸村里最漂亮的母狗小花。
其次就是智商。
它的智商已经超出其他狗类太多，主人说什么话，做什么事。
只要不是太高深，它几乎都懂。
甚至还能把家里那只养了三年，见人就啄，鸡冠血红的雄伟大公鸡耍得团团转。
时不时假扮母鸡的叫声勾引它出鸡笼，到了外面好一顿戏弄。
弄得大公鸡一见它就蔫吧。
李向东下意识的不相信那些封建迷信，转念一想。
他连“长生经”这种功法都得到了手，这世上还有什么事是不可能。
心里想清楚过后，郑重的抬起头对父亲说道：
“爸，妈、不管大黄以后会变成什么样，它始终都是我们家里的一份子。”
“希望你们不要用另类的眼光看待它。”

刘月红做不出决定看向李为民，李为民听着儿子的话，久久不言语。
啪嗒啪嗒又是几口烟下去后，他放下旱烟枪吼道：
“大黄，你个狗东西，不回来把鸡架吃完老子打死你。”
大黄听的熟悉的吼叫声，猛地抬起脑袋一蹦三尺高。
随即脚步飞快的冲进来大快朵颐。
李向东看着它恢复到没心没肺的样子，心里也很高兴。
转过身悄悄运起麒麟神瞳，想看看它身体倍棒的原因。
谁知不看不知道，一看吓一跳。
大黄看着健康，胃里面居然长出一个婴儿拳头大的灰色东西。
好似一个肿瘤！
怎么会这样？
李向东心里大惊，正欲上前搂住它细看，忽然反应过来。
不对，这不是肿瘤，这是狗宝！难得一见的大狗宝！

In the past two years since Li Xiangdong was stupid, Dahuang has always been his most considerate playmate.
Even after recovering from the illness, I didn't notice the changes in it.
At this moment, when Li Weimin reminded him, he realized that for a dog, it was indeed somewhat abnormal.
The first is age.
All the dogs of his age in the village had died long ago and were buried.
Or he is so old that his hair has fallen out and he can no longer walk, and he will not be able to survive this winter.
It's still jumping around, baring its teeth and fighting even more fiercely than a three- or four-year-old male dog.
They often bite her and run around, dominating Xiaohua, the most beautiful female dog in the village.
The second is IQ.
Its IQ is much higher than other dogs, no matter what its owner says or does.
As long as it's not too advanced, it understands almost everything.
I can even keep the majestic rooster that I have raised at home for three years, and pecks everyone when I see it, and plays around with it with its blood-red comb.
From time to time, he would pretend to be a hen and lure him out of the coop, and then he would be teased outside.
Make the big cock wilt at the sight of it.
Li Xiangdong subconsciously didn't believe in those feudal superstitions, so he thought about it again.
He has even mastered the "Eternal Life Sutra", so nothing else in this world is impossible.
After thinking clearly in his mind, he solemnly raised his head and said to his father:
"Dad, Mom, no matter what Rhubarb will become in the future, it will always be a part of our family."
"I hope you won't look at it in a different light."
Liu Yuehong couldn't make a decision and looked at Li Weimin. Li Weimin listened to his son's words and remained silent for a long time.
After a few more puffs of smoke, he put down his pipe and shouted:
"Dahuang, you bitch, if you don't come back and finish the chicken rack, I'll beat you to death."
Hearing the familiar roar, Dahuang suddenly raised his head and jumped three feet high.
Then he rushed in quickly and had a good meal.
Li Xiangdong was very happy to see it return to its heartless appearance.
He turned around and quietly picked up the Qilin Divine Eye, wanting to see why its body was so powerful.
Who knows whether you have seen it or not, you will be shocked when you see it.
Rhubarb looked healthy, but a gray thing as big as a baby's fist grew in his stomach.
Like a tumor!
how so?
Li Xiangdong was shocked. He was about to step forward to hug it and take a closer look, when he suddenly came to his senses.
No, this is not a tumor, this is a dog baby! A rare big dog treasure!
